nolocreas.description: Educational Android application focused on helping users improve their web security awareness by reviewing links and teaching safer browsing practices.
nolocreas.a1: Built an educational Android app to help users identify safer browsing practices and improve web security awareness.
nolocreas.a2: Integrated Firebase services to support backend-connected application features.
nolocreas.a3: Developed the mobile experience in Java following Material Design principles for a clean and accessible UI.
nolocreas.a4: Focused the product on link validation and user-oriented security education.

gopoli.description: Institutional Android application for Politécnico Grancolombiano featuring campus services, OAuth2/OIDC authentication, hardware sensor integration, and Android background services.
gopoli.a1: Led development and release, designing a clean, Material Design-compliant UI/UX.
gopoli.a2: Integrated Android hardware sensors including step counter functionality for activity tracking features.
gopoli.a3: Implemented Android Services and background processing for persistent application tasks and notifications.
gopoli.a4: Integrated third-party APIs including OAuth2/OIDC authentication, academic systems, and Firebase Cloud Messaging.
gopoli.a5: Performed testing, debugging, and performance optimisation across multiple Android versions and devices.

androidtv.description: Independent research and development focused on Android TV media streaming technologies using ExoPlayer and IPTV protocols.
androidtv.a1: Implemented adaptive video streaming using ExoPlayer for Android TV environments.
androidtv.a2: Worked with IPTV M3U8 playlists and live media streaming playback.
androidtv.a3: Explored buffering optimisation, media session handling, and playback performance.
androidtv.a4: Tested streaming compatibility across different Android TV devices and network conditions.

qinaya.description: Android application focused on providing low-cost cloud computer access through subscription-based remote desktop services.
qinaya.a1: Developed Android features for cloud-based remote desktop access and subscription management.
qinaya.a2: Worked on secure authentication flows and stable communication between Android clients and remote systems.
qinaya.a3: Optimised application performance and connection stability across different Android devices and network conditions.
qinaya.a4: Collaborated on improving user experience for low-latency remote access sessions.

daviplata.description: Development and maintenance of key features for Colombia's most-used financial app, serving over 18 million active users.
daviplata.a1: Ensured the stability, security, and smooth processing of millions of daily transactions on Android and Huawei builds.
daviplata.a2: Drove performance optimisation and incident resolution.
daviplata.a3: Delivered continuous improvements to the UI and integrations with banking services.

sibel.description: Specialised biometric solution deployed on Aratek Marshall 8 tablets for industrial environments.
sibel.a1: Integrated BMAPI SDK for fingerprint capture, MRZ reading, and QR code scanning.
sibel.a2: Optimised performance, stability, and power management for industrial Android devices.
sibel.a3: Contributed to PoC testing and UI adaptation across varied screen form factors.

dinastia.description: Native iOS application for pet management with a focus on smooth user journeys and high-performance API integrations.
dinastia.a1: Developed core pet management features adhering to Apple Human Interface Guidelines.
dinastia.a2: Designed and built Kotlin-based backend services to support mobile functionality.
dinastia.a3: Collaborated with product and engineering teams to deliver reliable, scalable, production-ready releases.

hero.subtitle: Senior Mobile Engineer (Android · iOS)
hero.desc: Building scalable mobile products with strong architecture, high performance, and measurable impact across fintech and enterprise environments.

about.title: Building mobile products that need to work at scale — and feel right for real users.
about.p1: I'm Kevin Paul Montealegre Melo, a Mobile Engineer based in Bogotá, focused on Android and iOS products with strong architecture, reliable performance, and measurable business impact.
about.p2: Over the last 6+ years, I've worked on fintech and enterprise solutions used by millions, building features that have to be stable, secure, and ready for real production environments.
about.p3: I enjoy working where product thinking and engineering discipline meet: clean architecture, maintainable codebases, performance optimisation, and teams that care about shipping with quality.
about.p4: I'm especially motivated by products that solve real problems, scale well, and require thoughtful technical decisions behind the scenes.
about.p5: Today, I'm open to remote and international opportunities where I can contribute as a senior mobile engineer, help strengthen mobile architecture, and keep building products with meaningful reach.
about.point2: Android-first, with iOS and cross-functional product experience
about.point3: Strong background in fintech, enterprise apps, and scalable mobile architecture
about.point4: Open to remote work and relocation
about.profile_role: Senior Mobile Engineer · Android · iOS · Product-minded architecture
about.availability: Open to remote work and international opportunities
